yew noun

also yew tree

classical

Caes. BG 6.31 (Lewis & Short)
Verg. G. 2.113 (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 16.50 (Lewis & Short)

taxus, taxī f.

noun, second declension

yew tree

Held to be poisonous, and so a tree of the underworld in the poets (Ov. Met. 4.432, Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • Bacchus amat collēs, Aquilōnem et frīgora taxī

    the vine loves hillsides, yews the north wind and the coldVerg. G. 2.113

See also tree, juniper, cypress, fir.

SourcesLewis & Short: taxus

Vergil, Georgica 2.113.
